newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino falls as merger speculation ebbs.
newsitem.headline: Casino falls as merger speculation ebbs.

text.p: Shares in retailer Casino were 1.5 percent lower at midday on Tuesday on waning speculation of a merger between the group and Promodes, another French retailer which last week sounded keen on a French alliance.
The stock was down 3.30 francs at 223.30 at 1020 GMT after having risen to a year high of 228 francs on Monday.

Promodes said it was not in talks with Casino and said chairman Paul-Louis Halley's remarks last week had led to false interpretations. Halley predicted a consolidation in the French retail sector and sounded open to an alliance.
"Speculation is unwinding, so there's profit-taking," a trader said.
Promodes shares were up two francs at 1,403.
